content.bridge_context: Tracing the evolution of how we exchange goods and services.

units.title: What is Barter?
units.explanation: Exchanging goods directly for other goods without using money. Example: trading grain for cloth.
units.dual_language_instruction: Trade a pencil for a pen with a friend. / एक दोस्त के साथ पेंसिल के बदले पेन का व्यापार करें।

units.title: Functions of Money
units.explanation: Money acts as a medium of exchange, a measure of value, and a store of value.
units.dual_language_instruction: List two forms of modern money. / आधुनिक धन के दो रूपों की सूची बनाएं।
